payload.summary: Codex (gpt-5.6-terra) reviewed PR #2 twice. First pass REQUEST CHANGES on a real finding: the CSS-text guard matched any rule padding and only required one gutter reference, so it would still pass after a second selector picked up the gutter — the exact regression it was written to catch. Rewrote it to extract each rule declaration block by selector and to assert exactly one var(--felt-gutter) consumer; mutation-checked by insetting .burn-scrim with the gutter, which now fails two tests. Re-review APPROVE (run b7mb4kfe). Both runs noted the known worker-sandbox degradation: nahel and bun are not on the reviewer PATH, so it verified statically and the host ran the suite.
